fields.typeLabel: array of command patterns

fields.description: Refuse to start when the sandbox can't, instead of running unsandboxed
fields.typeLabel: Boolean    true: Claude Code exits with an error at startup when sandbox.enabled is true but the sandbox can't start    false: Claude Code runs commands unsandboxed when the sandbox can't start

fields.description: Control which paths sandboxed commands can read and write
fields.default: unset, so the default read and write boundaries apply
fields.typeLabel: object with allowWrite, denyWrite, denyRead, and allowRead arrays, plus the allowManagedReadPathsOnly and disabled Booleans

fields.description: Re-open reading inside a region denyRead blocks
fields.typeLabel: array of path strings, using the sandbox path prefixes

fields.description: Add paths sandboxed commands can write to
fields.default: unset, so sandboxed commands can write to the working directory, the per-user temp directory, directories you've added …
fields.typeLabel: array of path strings, using the sandbox path prefixes

fields.description: Block sandboxed commands from reading specific paths
fields.default: unset, so sandboxed commands keep the default read access, which includes credential files such as ~/.aws/credentials
fields.typeLabel: array of path strings, using the sandbox path prefixes

fields.description: Block sandboxed commands from writing to specific paths
fields.typeLabel: array of path strings, using the sandbox path prefixes

fields.description: Turn off filesystem isolation while keeping network isolation
fields.default: false, so filesystem isolation stays on
fields.typeLabel: Boolean    true: Claude Code skips filesystem isolation and keeps network isolation    false: filesystem isolation stays on

fields.description: Silence violation reports for paths a command is expected to probe
fields.default: unset, so every violation is reported
fields.typeLabel: object mapping a command substring to an array of violation substrings, usually paths

fields.description: Control which hosts, ports, and sockets sandboxed commands reach
fields.default: unset, so no domains are pre-allowed and your permission mode decides what happens to each new host
fields.typeLabel: object with the sub-keys below

fields.description: Let sandboxed commands connect to every Unix socket
fields.typeLabel: Boolean    true: sandboxed commands can connect to every Unix socket    false: the sandbox blocks Unix-socket connections: on macOS except the paths in allowUnixSockets, and on Linux and WSL2 through the seccomp filter when it's present

fields.description: Pre-allow domains so sandboxed commands don't prompt for them
fields.default: unset, so your permission mode decides what happens to each new host
fields.typeLabel: array of strings, each a domain, wildcard pattern, or IP literal, with an optional :port suffix

fields.description: Let sandboxed commands listen on network ports and connect to localhost on macOS
fields.typeLabel: Boolean    true: sandboxed commands on macOS can listen on any local address and connect to any port on localhost    false: sandboxed commands on macOS can't listen on a port or connect directly to servers on localhost

fields.description: Let macOS sandboxed tools like the iOS Simulator or Playwright reach their XPC services
fields.typeLabel: array of strings, each a service name; a single trailing  matches a prefix, and "" alone matches every service

fields.description: List Unix socket paths sandboxed commands can use on macOS
fields.default: unset, so the macOS sandbox blocks every Unix socket
fields.typeLabel: array of strings, each a socket path

fields.description: Block domains for sandboxed commands, even inside an allowed wildcard
fields.typeLabel: array of strings, each a domain, wildcard pattern, or IP literal, with an optional :port suffix

fields.description: Route sandbox HTTP traffic through your own proxy
fields.default: unset, so Claude Code runs its own proxy
fields.typeLabel: number, a local TCP port

fields.description: Route sandbox SOCKS traffic through your own proxy
fields.default: unset, so Claude Code runs its own proxy
fields.typeLabel: number, a local TCP port

fields.description: Deny hosts outside the allowlist instead of prompting
fields.typeLabel: Boolean    true: Claude Code denies sandboxed commands access to hosts outside the allowlist    false: unless another trusted settings file sets true, Claude Code decides a host outside the allowlist by permission mode instead of denying it outright: in auto mode it checks the host against the command's per-command allowed domains, in dontAsk mode it denies, in bypassPermissions mode and in interactive terminal plan-mode sessions where bypass is available it allows, and otherwise it asks you

fields.description: Have the sandbox proxy terminate TLS so it can read HTTPS requests
fields.default: unset, so the proxy doesn't terminate or inspect TLS
fields.typeLabel: object with optional caCertPath and caKeyPath strings, each a file path

fields.description: Use your own ripgrep binary inside the sandbox
fields.default: unset, so the sandbox uses the same ripgrep binary as Claude Code. That is the bundled binary unless you set USE_BUILTI…
fields.typeLabel: object with command, the path to the ripgrep binary, and optional args, an array of arguments to prepend

fields.description: Show a "clear context" option on the plan accept screen
fields.typeLabel: Boolean    true: the plan approval menu gets a first option, Yes, clear context and …, that approves the plan and clears the conversation context    false: the plan approval menu shows no clear-context option

fields.description: See summaries of Claude's thinking instead of a collapsed stub
fields.typeLabel: Boolean    true: you see full thinking summaries when you expand thinking with Ctrl+O    false: the Anthropic API redacts thinking blocks and Claude Code shows a collapsed stub

fields.description: Hide the "Cooked for" duration after each response
fields.typeLabel: Boolean    true: you see the turn duration message after each response    false: Claude Code hides the turn duration message

fields.description: Reserve more or less context for the skill listing
fields.default: 0.01, which reserves 1% of the context window
fields.typeLabel: number, a fraction greater than 0 and at most 1

fields.description: Cap each skill's description length in the skill listing
fields.typeLabel: number of characters, a positive integer

fields.description: Hide or collapse a skill without editing its SKILL.md
fields.typeLabel: object mapping skill name to one of:    "on": Claude sees the skill and you can type /name    "name-only": Claude sees the skill by name without its description    "user-invocable-only": Claude doesn't see the skill, but you can still type /name    "off": Claude doesn't see the skill and /name is hidden from autocomplete

fields.description: Skip the one-time notice Claude Code shows when you first enter auto mode yourself rather than through the built-in default
fields.default: unset, so the notice appears once
fields.typeLabel: Boolean    true: Claude Code skips the notice    false: the same as unset; the notice appears once unless another of these files sets true

fields.description: Skip the confirmation dialog before bypassPermissions mode
fields.typeLabel: Boolean    true: Claude Code skips the confirmation dialog before a session enters bypassPermissions mode    false: the same as unset; the dialog appears unless another of these files sets true

fields.description: Skip the WebFetch hostname check when Anthropic is unreachable
fields.default: unset, so the check runs before the first fetch to each hostname in a session
fields.typeLabel: Boolean    true: Claude Code skips the WebFetch domain safety check    false: the check runs before the first fetch to each hostname in a session, and again for a hostname whose earlier check was blocked or failed

fields.description: Underline misspelled words in the prompt input with a spell checker you install
fields.default: unset, so spell checking is off; checker defaults to "auto", the first of the three found on PATH; language defaults to…
fields.typeLabel: object with enabled (Boolean), checker ("aspell", "hunspell", "ispell", or "auto"), language (string, passed to the checker as its dictionary name), and color (string, a terminal color name, #rrggbb, rgb(r,g,b), ansi256(n), or ansi:<name>)

fields.description: Hide tips in the spinner while Claude works
fields.typeLabel: Boolean    true: you see tips in the spinner while Claude is working    false: Claude Code hides spinner tips

fields.description: Add your own tips to the spinner rotation, or replace the built-in tips
fields.default: unset, so Claude Code shows only the built-in tips
fields.typeLabel: object with tips, tipsFile, label, and excludeDefault fields, each optional

fields.description: Add or replace the verbs shown while a turn runs
fields.default: unset, so Claude Code uses the built-in verbs
fields.typeLabel: object with a verbs array of strings and mode, one of:    "append": Claude Code adds your verbs to the built-in set    "replace": Claude Code shows only your verbs

fields.description: Add SSH connections to the Desktop environment dropdown
fields.typeLabel: array of objects, each with required id, name, and sshHost and optional sshPort and sshIdentityFile

fields.description: Run your own command to render a status line below the prompt
fields.typeLabel: object with type set to "command" and a command string, plus optional padding as a number of characters, refreshInterval as a number of seconds, minimum 1, and hideVimModeIndicator as a Boolean

fields.description: Choose the prompt cache lifetime for subagents and other requests outside the main conversation
fields.default: unset, so each of these requests gets its default lifetime
fields.typeLabel: string, one of:    "5m": the cache holds for five minutes    "1h": the cache holds for an hour

fields.description: Rewrite rows in the subagent task display with your own command
fields.default: unset, so Claude Code renders the default rows
fields.typeLabel: object with type set to "command" and a command string

fields.description: Switch models automatically or pause when a safety classifier flags a request
fields.default: unset. Claude Code switches automatically, though it may ask first in an interactive session
fields.typeLabel: Boolean    true: Claude Code switches to the fallback model and continues    false: in an interactive session Claude Code pauses so you can choose between switching and editing the prompt; where no dialog can show, such as a -p run, the flagged request ends as an error

fields.description: Stop loading the plugins enabled on your claude.ai account and stop downloading new ones
fields.default: unset, so sessions signed in with your claude.ai account sync your plugins
fields.typeLabel: Boolean    false: Claude Code stops downloading synced plugins and stops loading the ones already in ~/.claude/plugins/synced/. In user or managed settings, it also moves them to ~/.claude/plugins/.trash/    true: the same as unset

fields.description: Stop loading the skills enabled on your claude.ai account and stop downloading new ones
fields.default: unset, so sessions signed in with your claude.ai account sync your skills
fields.typeLabel: Boolean    false: Claude Code stops downloading synced skills and stops loading the ones already in ~/.claude/skills/synced/. In user or managed settings, it also moves them to ~/.claude/skills/.trash/    true: the same as unset

fields.description: Turn off syntax highlighting in diffs and code blocks
fields.typeLabel: Boolean    true: Claude Code turns off syntax highlighting in diffs, code blocks, and file previews    false: Claude Code highlights syntax

fields.description: Removed in v2.1.277, together with the TaskOutput tool it sized
Choose how agent team teammates display
fields.typeLabel: string, one of:    "in-process": teammates run inside your main terminal pane    "auto": split panes when you're running inside tmux, or inside iTerm2 with it2 on your PATH or tmux installed; in-process otherwise    "tmux": split panes using tmux or iTerm2, detected from your terminal    "iterm2": iTerm2 native split panes through the it2 CLI

fields.description: Hide the terminal progress bar in terminals that support it
fields.typeLabel: Boolean    true: you see the terminal progress bar in terminals that support it    false: Claude Code hides the terminal progress bar

fields.description: Stop /rename and --name from changing the terminal tab title
fields.typeLabel: Boolean    true: the terminal tab title shows the session name you set    false: the tab keeps the title Claude Code generates from your conversation

fields.description: Pick the interface color theme, built-in or custom
fields.typeLabel: string, one of:    "auto": matches your terminal's light or dark background    "dark": the dark theme    "light": the light theme    "dark-daltonized": the dark theme with colorblind-friendly colors    "light-daltonized": the light theme with colorblind-friendly colors    "dark-ansi": the dark theme using only your terminal's ANSI color palette    "light-ansi": the light theme using only your terminal's ANSI color palette    "custom:<slug>" or "custom:<plugin-name>:<slug>": a custom theme from ~/.claude/themes/ or a plugin

fields.description: Show the times in the interface on a 12-hour or 24-hour clock, in UTC, or with a strftime pattern
fields.typeLabel: string, one of:    "auto": the same as unset; each time keeps its built-in format, which follows your locale on the turn duration message    "12-hour": a 12-hour clock    "24-hour": a 24-hour clock    "24-hour-utc": a 24-hour clock in UTC with Z after the minutes, such as 18:05Z; Claude Code ignores timeZone for this preset   * A strftime pattern such as "%H:%M": Claude Code writes each time with the pattern. Any value that contains a % is a pattern, and any other value outside the presets counts as "auto"

fields.description: Show the times in the interface in a time zone other than your system's
fields.default: unset, so times show in your system time zone
fields.typeLabel: string, an IANA time zone name. When Claude Code doesn't recognize the name, it uses your system time zone

fields.description: Choose the fullscreen or classic terminal renderer
fields.default: unset, so Claude Code picks the renderer for you
fields.typeLabel: string, one of:    "default": the classic main-screen renderer    "fullscreen": the flicker-free alt-screen renderer with virtualized scrollback

fields.description: Have Claude plan a workflow for each substantive task without being asked
fields.typeLabel: Boolean    true: sessions start with ultracode on when dynamic workflows are enabled for you and your model supports xhigh    false: sessions start with ultracode off

fields.description: Let the auto mode classifier review shell commands in plan mode; set false to get prompts instead
fields.typeLabel: Boolean    true: the same as unset; when auto mode is available, the classifier reviews each shell command during planning instead of prompting you for it, except critical-path removals. A false in any of these files still turns it off    false: you get a permission prompt for every command outside the built-in read-only set

fields.description: Show full tool output instead of truncated summaries; viewMode takes precedence when both are set
fields.typeLabel: Boolean    true: you see full tool output    false: you see truncated summaries of tool output

fields.description: Start every session in default, verbose, or focus view
fields.default: unset, so the verbose setting and your last /focus choice apply
fields.typeLabel: string, one of:    "default": the normal transcript with truncated tool output    "verbose": the transcript with full tool output   * "focus": only your last prompt, a one-line summary of tool calls with edit diffstats, and the final response. Focus view needs the fullscreen renderer

fields.description: Map a two-key INSERT-mode sequence such as jj to Escape
fields.typeLabel: object mapping a two-character sequence to "<Esc>"

fields.description: Turn on voice dictation and pick hold or tap mode
fields.default: unset, so dictation is off; when enabled is true and mode is unset, Claude Code uses "hold"
fields.typeLabel: object with enabled as a Boolean, autoSubmit as a Boolean that applies in hold mode only, and mode, one of:    "hold": you hold the dictation key while speaking and release it to stop    "tap": you tap the key once to start recording and again to send

fields.description: Turn on voice dictation with the older single-key form
fields.typeLabel: Boolean    true: voice dictation is on when you're logged in with a claude.ai account and your organization's policy allows voice, unless voice.enabled is set    false: voice dictation is off, unless voice.enabled is set

fields.description: Turn off mouse-wheel acceleration in fullscreen rendering
fields.typeLabel: Boolean    true: Claude Code accelerates mouse-wheel scroll speed during fast scrolls    false: Claude Code scrolls at a constant rate per wheel notch

fields.description: Let the word ultracode in a prompt start a workflow; set false to type it without starting one
fields.typeLabel: Boolean    true: typing ultracode in a prompt triggers a dynamic workflow    false: you can type the word without triggering one

fields.description: Set the agent count Claude aims for in dynamic workflows
fields.default: "medium", or "small" when you're signed in on a Pro plan with Claude Code v2.1.271 or later
fields.typeLabel: string, one of:    "unrestricted": no guideline, so Claude sizes the workflow to the task    "small": Claude aims for fewer than 5 agents    "medium": Claude aims for fewer than 10 agents    "large": Claude aims for fewer than 50 agents

fields.description: Configure how Claude Code creates git worktrees
fields.typeLabel: object with baseRef, symlinkDirectories, sparsePaths, and bgIsolation

fields.description: Branch new worktrees from the remote default branch or your local HEAD
fields.typeLabel: string, one of:    "fresh": new worktrees branch from origin/<default-branch>    "head": new worktrees branch from your current local HEAD, including unpushed commits

fields.description: Let background sessions edit the working copy without a worktree
fields.typeLabel: string, one of:    "worktree": Claude Code blocks Edit and Write in the main checkout until the session calls EnterWorktree    "none": background jobs edit the working copy directly

fields.description: Choose where Desktop SSH sessions create their worktrees on a remote machine
fields.default: unset, so worktrees go inside the project
fields.typeLabel: string, an absolute path or one that starts with ~/

fields.description: Check out only the directories you need in each worktree
fields.default: unset, so each worktree checks out the whole tree
fields.typeLabel: array of strings, directory paths relative to the repository root

fields.description: Symlink large directories into each worktree instead of duplicating them
fields.default: unset, so Claude Code symlinks no directories
fields.typeLabel: array of strings, directory paths relative to the repository root
